title: Topological signatures in large-scale structure
html: The \mathrm{SO}(3) holonomy of the bulk bundle (\mathbb{C}-quantum universe) and the monodromy fixed points of the (quantum characteristic classes) may leave topological imprints on the large-scale distribution of matter. Such imprints include preferred filamentary alignments or voids correlated with the brane tower structure (recursive brane tower).
